WHY ANOTHER CALENDAR?

Because layout is infrastructure, not a licence tier.

Resource scheduling should not force your product into a vendor’s visual language—or its premium plan. Headless Scheduler gives you date math, collision geometry, input behavior, and accessible navigation as typed primitives.

01 / LAYOUT
Resource timelines

Hours or days across any number of people, rooms, tools, or tracks. Clipping and percentages are already calculated.

02 / MONTHS
Keep scrolling

Windowed month models make an endless vertical calendar practical without rendering an endless DOM.

03 / INPUT
Move like you mean it

Pointer capture, snapping, resize handles, keyboard intent, and live announcements—without prescribing components.

15 min

ONE PACKAGE. BRING YOUR STACK.

Ship the scheduler, not the fight.

ESM, CJS, declarations, zero runtime dependencies in the core. React is optional.

Terminal
Copy
$ npm install headless-scheduler
› import { createScheduler } from 'headless-scheduler'

SMALL ON PURPOSE

Primitives you can hold in your head
createScheduler(options)
buildResourceTimeline(input)
getContinuousMonthWindow(input)
createPointerInteraction(options)
getGridNavigation(input)

printed your way.
